creator: chase_ai_
title: New /design skill (research preview) puts Claude Design's editable artboard workflow inside Claude Code CLI/Desktop, stackable with Impeccable and Taste skills

tools.name: Claude Code /design skill
tools.detail: type `/design <prompt>`; generates multi-artboard canvas with properties panel; shown on Claude Code v2.1.251

tools.name: Claude Design (web app)
tools.detail: standalone artboard designer that /design now replicates inside Claude Code

claims: /design is Claude Code's biggest design upgrade 'in a long time'
/design essentially inserts the standalone Claude Design web app into Claude Code itself
Creates as many variations as asked and places them on an artboard; demo had 3 landing-page variations in 3 styles
Clicking any component opens a detailed properties panel on the right where 'virtually anything' can be edited
Removes the old Claude Design -> share -> zip -> point Claude Code at it transfer step
Because it runs inside Claude Code, other skills (Impeccable, Taste) can be stacked with it
how_to_steps: In Claude Code (CLI or Desktop), type /design followed by your prompt
Optionally tell it to use other front-end skills like Impeccable or the Taste skill
Claude generates multiple variations on an artboard canvas
Click components to edit via the properties panel; iterate before committing
Pick one and have Claude Code implement it
on_screen_only: Tweet from @ClaudeDevs: 'Claude Code can design now. The new /design skill (research preview) brings Claude Design's artboard workflow into the CLI and Desktop, built on artifacts. Run /design to get editable artboards for your UI -- pick one, tweak it, then have Claude implement it.'
Terminal header: Claude Code v2.1.251, Fable 5 with medium effort, C:\Users\Chase; 'Using Fable 5 (from .claude\settings.json) +1 more /status'; 'bypass permissions on (shift+tab to cycle)'
Slash command autocomplete: '/design  Create a design canvas... multi-artboard visual...' and a second entry 'Grant or revoke Claude ... access to your Design'

Artboards named 'A -- The Time Clock', 'B -- The Brocade', 'C -- The Rhythm Section' for a payroll SaaS landing page: 'NOBODY PUNCHES IN FOR PAYROLL ANYMORE.' / 'A thousand small decisions, woven into one correct payday.' / 'Set payday once. It loops forever.'
Properties panel tabs Edit / Code / Tweaks; fields Content, Font, Size, Weight, Leading, Case, Sizing, Width, Height, Align, Grow, Position, Z-index; 'Commit changes' button
Long design brief in a side pane describing each variant's typography (Playfair/Newsreader/Space Grotesk) and 'three words' per concept
cta: Check out the full deep dive on the creator's YouTube

gap.what: The liked set covers Claude Design (web app, /clone-site, handoff) and Impeccable/Taste, but not the new in-CLI /design skill (research preview) with editable artboards and a properties panel, nor stacking it with design skills in one session.

relevance.why: Direct Claude Code feature that collapses the design-to-code loop for a solo founder shipping app UIs; no new tool to buy.

implement_score.why: Zero setup if Claude Code is current: run /design with a landing-page or screen brief, add 'use impeccable', pick a variant, implement. Worth doing on the next UI task.
